packageRules.description: Group js-xbbg runtime package updates separately from tooling.
Published npm packages keep supporting older majors: widen runtime and peer ranges instead of raising their floors.
Keep internally stamped JS platform package versions under release scripts.

uv publishes its crates as exact 0.0.x pins with no semver promise, rattler crates are pinned exactly and depend on each other's exact versions, and xbbg-sdk passes rattler's authentication middleware into uv's client, so both share astral-reqwest-middleware (and astral-reqwest-retry, renamed reqwest-middleware/reqwest-retry in Cargo.toml). Move them all in one PR: a split update does not compile.
Group Java build tooling: Maven and Gradle wrappers, Maven plugins, Gradle plugins and test libraries (java-xbbg).
Arrow Java is an optional dependency of io.github.underloam:xbbg-jdk17: keep its updates apart from build tooling.
The xbbg artifacts are this repository's own: their versions are stamped at publish time, and the consumer smoke projects must keep testing the locally built jar.
Group Python, PEP 621, and Pixi updates.

Published Python packages keep supporting older dependency majors (e.g. pandas 2, polars 1): widen the upper bound when a new major lands, never raise the floor. The floors CI job tests the lower bounds.
Supported runtime floors change deliberately: requires-python follows the CPython end-of-life schedule and Node engines follow the Node.js release schedule.

Pixi pins that encode support contracts: python matches the tested CPython range (the requires-python floor up to the newest wheel-matrix version, a ceiling requires-python deliberately omits) and the per-version test environments, rust tracks the workspace rust-version (MSRV), libclang is the bindgen floor, and nodejs mirrors engines. Lock-file maintenance still refreshes them within range.
Group CI and wheel-build base image updates.
manylinux images are tagged by build date (YYYY.MM.DD-N).
